name: Josh Hawley

lean.basis: Republican senator from Missouri since 2019 (attorney general 2017–2019); first senator to announce an objection to certifying the 2020 election; described as populist and socially conservative.

sources.title: Josh Hawley — Wikipedia

summary: Josh Hawley, a former clerk to Chief Justice John Roberts and Missouri attorney general, has been a Republican senator from Missouri since 2019. His speech at the first National Conservatism Conference in 2019, attacking a "cosmopolitan elite", made him an early face of the movement (critics, including the ADL, called the language antisemitic; he rejected that); he gave NatCon keynotes again in 2021 and 2022.
